bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · MACD 下穿，跌破 $106

read.en: Corning fell 2.0% on Nov 19 to $105.97, trading $105.83–114.00 on light volume (0.67x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($108.6), 10-day ($111.7), 30-day ($124.6) and 100-day ($148.8), all falling, and the 200-day ($156.6, rising). MACD crossed below its signal on Nov 19, below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 11 ($104.35), and RSI is 36.5.
read.zh: 康宁 11月19日下跌 2.0%，收于 $105.97，盘中区间 $105.83–114.00，成交量偏低（为 20 日均量的 0.67 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$108.6）、10 日（$111.7）、30 日（$124.6）和 100 日均线（$148.8）下方，四者均在下行，也低于 200 日均线（$156.6，上行）。MACD 于 11月19日下穿信号线，在零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 11月11日起看多（$104.35），RSI 为 36.5。

read.en: The $114 high was rejected at the Nov 13 close ($114.08), and the close broke the $106.1–106.2 support (Nov 6 and 16 closes, Nov 18 low), now resistance. Resistance is $106.1–106.2, then $108.2–108.6 (Nov 17 and 18 closes, 5-day) and $111.4–112.1 (10-day, Nov 18 high, Nov 10 close). Support is $104.1–104.4 (SAR, Nov 6 and 17 lows), then $101.8–103.4 (Nov 5). A close above $108.6 would target $111.7; below $104.35, the SAR would flip bearish.

r.en: Nov 18 low $106.09; Nov 6 close $106.13; Nov 16 close $106.17, lost

s.en: Nov 6 low $104.07; Parabolic SAR $104.35; Nov 17 low $104.42
